title: Nostradamus Effect: The Third Antichrist (S1, E1) | Full Episode | History
summary: A History channel episode presents believers' readings of Nostradamus's three Antichrists (Napoleon, Hitler, one to come) and biblical end-times prophecy as signs of an approaching apocalyptic war.

assertions.quote: The third Antichrist very soon annihilated, 27 years his bloody war will last.

verdicts.note: The quatrains are vague verse read after the fact; none names a third world war, its date or its parties, and no reading has forecast a war before it happened.

assertions.quote: Many believe that if Nostradamus successfully predicted the appearance of Napoleon and Hitler, his prophecy of the third Antichrist is also likely to come true.

verdicts.note: 'Hister' is the Latin name of the Danube and the Napoleon anagram needs letter swaps; the matches were fitted after the events.

assertions.quote: This biblical text purports that a so-called savior will set the conditions for Armageddon.
That began in some Bible scholars' opinion the last days as we know it today.

verdicts.note: Reading modern Israel as a sign of the end times is religious interpretation that no evidence can settle.

assertions.quote: Nuclear weapons among rogue nations have increased tenfold.

verdicts.note: North Korea, the only such state with nuclear weapons, has grown its arsenal to an estimated few dozen warheads, but Iran has none and no other rogue state has built one.
SIPRI shows North Korea's arsenal (about 60 warheads) growing with accelerating fissile production, but it is the only such state with weapons; Iran has none.
